title: Root Canal Treatment
description:
Root Canal Treatment (RCT) is a safe and effective dental procedure used to treat infected or damaged teeth. During the treatment, the infected pulp inside the tooth is removed, and the tooth is thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and sealed. This helps relieve pain, stop the spread of infection, and preserve the natural tooth structure.
Modern root canal procedures are comfortable, minimally painful, and performed under local anesthesia. After treatment, a dental crown may be placed to restore the tooth’s strength and appearance. With proper care and oral hygiene, a root canal-treated tooth can last for many years.
